verdict.rationale: Slack documents first-party paths for putting agents into conversations. It has a 'Create an agent' guide, and the Events API is described as the way to 'build apps and bots that respond to activities in Slack', with chat.postMessage for replying in channels. Slack also markets agents such as ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and coding agents as teammates connected to your conversations, and 'bot user' appears in its add-apps help. missing for 10: explicit documentation that an agent is invited as a channel member and triggered specifically by @mentions (e.g. an app_mention event), and independent or hands-on corroboration of mention-driven participation.
